description: Free, open-source local AI music studio: ACE-Step 1.5 and YuE2-3B text-to-music, stem separation, an AI arranger that adds parts to your track, a multitrack DAW, MIDI transcription and LoRA training.
summary: Local AI music studio unifying ACE-Step 1.5 and YuE2-3B in one Vue interface — text-to-music generation, stem separation, MIDI transcription, and LoRA fine-tuning, with a built-in multitrack DAW.
